newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia must pay 4.4 trln rbls wage arrears by Oct.
newsitem.headline: Russia must pay 4.4 trln rbls wage arrears by Oct.

text.p: The Russian government must pay 4.4 trillion roubles ($760 million) in wage arrears to the military and public employees by October to meet presidential promises, a Finance Ministry official said on Monday.

The federal government will have to pay 4.2 trillion roubles to the military and 0.2 trillion roubles to public employees by October to fulfill an order by President Boris Yeltsin, a Finance Ministry spokeswoman quoted Deputy Finance Minister Alexander Smirnov as saying.
The money will be repaid out of the federal budget, the spokeswoman quoted Smirnov as saying.

Last week Yeltsin ordered the government to pay wage arrears to the army within two months and other public sector workers such as teachers and doctors within three months. No figure for the amount of the arrears was then available.

Earlier, First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais said wage arrears to the military were about five trillion roubles. State Duma lower house of parliament social and labor policy committee head Sergei Kalashnikov said last week that military pay arrears were about half the 30 trillion roubles owed to the sector.

Wage and pension arrears is one of Russia's most acute social and economic problems rooted in a deep non-payment crisis between companies, tax non-payment and economic stagnation. Last week the government paid 22 trillion roubles in pension arrears to filfill an order from Yeltsin who is trying to soothe social unrest caused by the problem.
